CheckSpace

[core]

files.profiledef.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
iso_name="Forge"
iso_label="FORGE_69da5291af43"
iso_publisher="ArchMaker Forge <https://github.com/Alexendros/archmaker>"
iso_application="Forge, derivada de Arch Linux"
iso_version="69da5291af43"
install_dir="forge"
buildmodes=('iso')
bootmodes=('bios.syslinux' 'uefi.systemd-boot')
arch="x86_64"
pacman_conf="pacman.conf"
airootfs_image_type="squashfs"
airootfs_image_tool_options=('-comp' 'xz' '-Xbcj' 'x86' '-b' '1M' '-Xdict-size' '1M')
bootstrap_tarball_compression=('zstd' '-c' '-T0' '--auto-threads=logical' '--long' '-19')
file_permissions=(
["/etc/shadow"]="0:0:400"
["/etc/gshadow"]="0:0:400"
["/root"]="0:0:750"
["/root/user_configuration.json"]="0:0:600"
)
